rows.Kwic: 這箇是如來涅槃，那箇是法師涅槃？

Override.AttributionNote: Complete Book of the Five Lamps, volumes 1–33 (五燈全書(第1卷-第33卷)), Qin Batuo section. Qin Batuo is the exact speaker who rejects the lecturer Sheng's generic definition by saying, 'This one is the Tathagata's nirvana; which one is the Dharma teacher's nirvana?'

rows.Kwic: 聞巫者樂神云：識神無。忽然省悟。後參前關南，印其所解。

Override.AttributionNote: Complete Book of the Five Lamps, volumes 1–33 (五燈全書(第1卷-第33卷)), Guannan Daowu biography. Guannan Daowu is the exact grammatical actor who hears a spirit-medium's song saying 'Do you know the spirit?' and suddenly awakens; he later visits the former Guannan master, who certifies his understanding.
